docs.title: Commands
docs.text:
• mkdocs new [dir-name] - Create a new project.
  • mkdocs serve - Start the live-reloading docs server.
  • mkdocs build - Build the documentation site.
  • mkdocs -h - Print help message and exit.

docs/

docs.title: Introduction
docs.text:
Obsidian is a powerful knowledge management and note-taking application that uses markdown files for storage. It enables users to create and manage a personal knowledge base with interlinked notes.

Obsidian is designed to provide a flexible and customizable experience, allowing users to organize their thoughts in a non-linear manner. With features such as bidirectional linking, graph visualization, and plugin support, it serves as an essential tool for researchers, writers, students, and professionals.

Key advantages of Obsidian: - Offline-first: Your data is stored locally, ensuring privacy and security. - Customizable workflows: Use community plugins and themes to personalize the experience. - Markdown-based: Maintain a simple and universal file format for long-term accessibility. - Graph view and backlinks: Discover relationships between ideas effortlessly.

docs.title: Creating a Vault
docs.text: A Vault is a folder where Obsidian stores markdown files. 1. Open Obsidian. 2. Click Create a new vault. 3. Choose a name and location for your vault. 4. Click Create.

docs.title: Creating and Editing Notes
docs.text:
• Click on the + New Note button.
  • Use Markdown syntax for formatting: ```md # Heading 1 ## Heading 2 Bold text Italic text
  • Bullet List
  • Numbered List ```
  • Notes are automatically saved.

docs.title: Linking Notes
docs.text:
You can link notes using double brackets:

[[Note Title]]

This creates a connection between notes.

docs.title: Graph View
docs.text: To visualize your notes' connections: - Click on Graph View in the sidebar. - Explore links between different notes interactively.

docs.title: Plugins & Customization
docs.text: Obsidian offers core and community plugins: - Navigate to Settings > Community Plugins. - Browse and install plugins to extend functionality. - Customize themes under Settings > Appearance.

docs.title: Syncing Notes
docs.text: Obsidian provides a paid Obsidian Sync service, but you can also use: - iCloud Drive (macOS, iOS) - Google Drive / OneDrive - GitHub (Version Control)

docs.title: Exporting Notes
docs.text: You can export notes as: - Markdown (.md) - PDF (.pdf) - HTML (.html)

docs.title: Keyboard Shortcuts Windows/Mac
docs.text: Action Shortcut Open Quick Switcher Ctrl/Cmd + O Create a New Note Ctrl/Cmd + N Open Command Palette Ctrl/Cmd + P Toggle Sidebar Ctrl/Cmd + E Preview Mode Ctrl/Cmd + Shift + E

docs.title: Conclusion
docs.text: Obsidian is a powerful and flexible tool for managing notes and personal knowledge bases. By leveraging markdown, backlinks, and plugins, users can create a highly customizable workflow for note-taking and research.
